section_summary.extract_value: This introduction outlines a single preliminary study examining whether body image flexibility mediates the relationship between multiple body size discrepancy measures and body appreciation. The target sample is described as White older adolescent (pre-college/college-bound) females; no sample size, mean age, BMI values, survey method, or correlation coefficients are provided in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: Multiple sentences including: 'Specifically, this analysis ... in a sample of White older adolescent females on the developmental cusp of preparing to transition to early college life.' and 'The present study sought to further unpack the linkages among three types of body size discrepancies ... and two forms of contemporary positive body image.'
